converter.title: Convert PDF to Word in Seconds
converter.howTitle: How To Convert PDF to Word
steps: Drag and drop your PDF file, or choose it from your device.
Pick Word as the output format.
Press CONVERT NOW and wait a few seconds.
Download your editable DOCX — nothing leaves your device.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
items: Are my files uploaded?
No. ConvertPDF processes files entirely on your device. Nothing is sent to our servers.
Is it free?
Yes. Version 1.0 ships with all tools free. Optional Pro plans may come later — prices on this page are placeholders only.
Which platforms are supported?
iPhone, iPad, and Mac as one Universal Purchase. This website is the marketing and legal hub.
Can I use it offline?
Yes. Open a file in the app and work without a network connection.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
sections: Overview
ConvertPDF (“we”, “us”) respects your privacy. The ConvertPDF apps process your files locally on your device. We do not upload, store, or view your documents.
Your files
Conversion, merging, splitting, compression, OCR, redaction, annotation, and signing happen on your device. Your files are not transmitted to our servers for processing.
Information we may collect
We do not require an account to use the apps.
Optional, non-identifying crash or diagnostics data only if you opt in through the system or App Store.
Purchase or licence information, if you later buy optional features, is handled by Apple.
Information you choose to send when contacting support (for example an email you write to us).
Website
This marketing website does not require a login and does not process your PDF files. We may use essential hosting cookies. We do not sell personal information from this site.
Sharing
We do not sell personal information. We may share limited operational data with service providers who host this website, or where required by law.
Retention and security
App document processing stays on-device. Any support emails you send are kept only as long as needed to help you.
Your rights
Depending on where you live, you may have rights to access, correct, or delete personal data you sent us. Contact us to exercise them.
Children
ConvertPDF is not directed to children under 13.
Changes
We may update this policy and will post the new date here.
Contact

For privacy questions, use the Support page on this site or reply through App Store reviews / App Store Connect correspondence once the app is published. Email: support@convertpdf.app (placeholder until a mailbox is live).

support.title: Support
sections: How to get help
ConvertPDF is a native iPhone, iPad, and Mac app. For help with the app, use the App Store product page (Ratings & Reviews or the Support link once published), or email us.
App Store
Search for “ConvertPDF” on the App Store after release, open the product page, and use Apple’s support / review channels. Universal Purchase covers iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
Email
support@convertpdf.app — placeholder mailbox until the live inbox is configured. Include your device model, OS version, and a short description of the issue. Do not attach confidential PDFs.
Privacy & files
We cannot recover files from your device. ConvertPDF does not upload documents to our servers, so support cannot access your PDFs.
Website
This site hosts Privacy Policy, Terms of Use, and Support for App Store Connect. It does not process PDFs in the browser for production use.
